correctness.rationale: The submitted rank-one factorization X=uv^T with v^Tu=0 is (q-1)-to-one; Fourier orthogonality on u-perpendicular hyperplanes gives lambda(B)=q^(n-1)e(B)-(q^n-1)/(q-1), where B labels characters of sl_n modulo scalar matrices. The projective eigenspace count bounds the nonprincipal maximum by (q^(n-1)-1)^2/(q-1), attained only by split semisimple (n-1,1) types; irreducible B gives lambda_min=-(q^n-1)/(q-1). The n=2 Jordan/split/irreducible class enumeration supplies all multiplicities. The n=3 threshold and monotone ratio prove the Ramanujan iff n=2 boundary, retaining -k as trivial at q=2,n=2. Direct independent character-sum enumeration of every frequency for (n,q)=(2,2),(2,3),(2,5),(3,2) reproduced the complete spectra and extrema; finite prime-field tests do not prove extension-field cases or the general theorem.
